verdict.rationale: The documented API covers a broad share of UI functionality: customer creation and screening (sync, async and batch), case/alert/risk review and remediation (explicitly 'either via the web application or by integrating with the API'), monitoring config, exports, case audit trails, roles, transaction processing and webhooks, all described in a retrievable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema. However, there is no blanket parity claim, and API credentials (with their permissions and expiry) are documented only as generated in the web app under Settings. Risk-score equation and screening-configuration management are described only in UI terms. Missing for 10: a documented API/UI parity statement, API-based credential and access management, API endpoints for configuring risk-score equations and screening configurations, and independent hands-on corroboration.
